package.name: brightdrive_mapping
package.description: Mapping backend for BrightDrive: keyframes, GTSAM pose graph, GNSS and loop-closure factors, map assembly. FAST-LIO (OmerMersin/FAST_LIO_OUSTER @ 8ffac51) is the upstream LiDAR-inertial odometry; it is cloned unmodified in the Docker mapping stage and is not part of this package.
